evidence_class: response-open baseline design feasibility only; no TNC and no future response

bb_semantics.sampled_focal_absent: Code as 0 for the baseline visit.
bb_semantics.present_but_reported_without_numeric_cov: Quantitative anchor invalid; do not convert 'Reported' to a numeric cover score.
bb_semantics.annual_anchor_summary: Mean across eligible visits in the latest node-year only when every focal-present visit has numeric BB.

prospective_diagnostic.eligible_nodes: Only nodes with three distinct frozen q25/q50/q75 Thalassia-positive anchors and quantitative baseline BB at all three anchors.
prospective_diagnostic.future_outcome: Same permanent meter-mark Thalassia Braun-Blanquet score at the next fixed-transect survey; sampled focal absence may be coded 0, present nonnumeric 'Reported' is quantitatively missing.
prospective_diagnostic.predictor: anchor-level rhizome TNC centered within node: anchor_TNC - mean(anchor_TNC across the three anchors)
prospective_diagnostic.uncertainty: Stable-node cluster bootstrap with the entire three-anchor node resampled as one unit; exact code frozen before future outcome access.
prospective_diagnostic.role: Secondary spatial site-template-resistant diagnostic. It cannot replace or rescue the node-level primary TNC test.

intervention_boundary: Allowed only if the frozen core offset keeps destructive sampling outside the permanent meter-mark monitoring footprint.
Core anchor position may not move after TNC assay or preliminary environmental results.
If coring may plausibly alter the paired permanent meter mark, the future anchor diagnostic is invalid for that anchor rather than interpreted ecologically.
claim_boundary: Within-node centering and node fixed effects remove stable transect-level site identity, but not persistent meter-mark microhabitat or time-varying local common causes.
Braun-Blanquet is an ordinal cover score; effect size is interpreted as association on the frozen score scale, not exact percent-cover change.
This is a secondary prospective diagnostic, not a replacement for the node-level TNC primary.
Binary re-recording is not ecological recovery.
